title: kbsettings.layered raises must be an object for the list and string keys group, gate_checks and extension_paths, which its goal and the docs name
goal: kbsettings.layered(root, name) returns the merged value with its layer map for group (a string), gate_checks and extension_paths (lists of the layers in order), as kbext.SURFACE and kb/_self/extending.md describe them, instead of raising SettingsError 'must be an object'; kg_sync and kbext then read them through layered, not layer_files

run:
import json,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kbsettings
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"gate_checks":[["true"]],"extension_paths":["/x"],"group":"acme"}))
for name,want in (("gate_checks","true"),("extension_paths","/x"),("group","acme")):
    try:
        merged,layers=kbsettings.layered(d,name)
    except kbsettings.SettingsError as e:
        sys.exit("not yet: "+str(e))
    assert want in str(merged), (name,merged)

clauses.clause: kbsettings.layered(root, name) returns the merged value with its layer map for group (a string), gate_checks and extension_paths (lists of the layers in order), as kbext.SURFACE and kb/_self/extending.md describe them, instead of raising SettingsError 'must be an object'
kg_sync and kbext then read them through layered, not layer_files
